subject_note: In every requirement, 'the system' is the system of interest, the block SmartIntersectionCore.

ConfigureScenario.goal: Set up a scenario (traffic demand, road users, signal timing) that the system accepts as valid.

RunIntersection.goal: Start, pause and reset a run in which the system moves road users and switches signals safely.

InspectTelemetry.goal: Understand what the simulation is doing and why, from live state, events and metrics.

ExecuteTestRun.goal: Run a scenario repeatably and obtain traces and results for verification.

SubmitPerceptionDetections.goal: Deliver observations to the smart vehicle (planned extension; no requirements yet).

containers.name: SIS_Requirements
containers.text: The system shall fulfil the contained functional, non-functional and operational-design-domain requirements.

containers.name: FUN_Functional
containers.title: Functional requirements
containers.text: The system shall provide the contained functions.

containers.name: NFR_NonFunctional
containers.title: Non-functional requirements
containers.text: The system shall meet the contained quality requirements.

containers.name: ODD_OperationalDesignDomain
containers.title: Operational design domain
containers.text: The system shall operate within the operational design domain defined in Milestone 1.

containers.name: SIG_SignalControl
containers.title: Traffic signal control
containers.text: The system shall control the traffic signals of the intersection.

containers.name: RUN_ScenarioAndRunControl
containers.title: Scenario and run control
containers.text: The system shall let the operator configure scenarios and control runs.

containers.name: AGT_RoadUserBehaviour
containers.title: Road-user behaviour
containers.text: The system shall simulate the behaviour of vehicle and pedestrian agents.

containers.name: SV_SmartVehicle
containers.title: Smart-vehicle perception and decision
containers.text: The system shall make the smart vehicle decide on what it observes.

containers.name: OBS_TelemetryAndEvaluation
containers.title: Telemetry and evaluation
containers.text: The system shall make the state and the results of every run observable.

requirements.name: SIG_01_PhaseSequence
requirements.text: The system shall switch the vehicle signals in the repeating sequence N/S green, N/S amber, all-red, E/W green, E/W amber, all-red.
requirements.rationale: This is the signal plan of the ODD: two mutually exclusive movement groups, separated by amber and all-red.

requirements.name: SIG_02_NoConflictingGreens
requirements.text: While one vehicle movement group shows green or amber, the system shall show red to the other vehicle movement group.
requirements.rationale: Main safety rule: crossing traffic streams never have permission at the same time.
requirements.source: Road authority; occupants; drivers; check T1

requirements.name: SIG_03_ProtectedCrossing
requirements.text: While a pedestrian crossing shows walk or clearance, the system shall show red to every vehicle movement group that crosses it.
requirements.rationale: Pedestrians on a crossing are never in conflict with vehicles that have permission.
requirements.source: Pedestrians; road authority; check T1; conflict C1

requirements.name: SIG_04_ServeCrossingRequest
requirements.text: When a pedestrian agent requests to cross, the system shall show walk on that crossing within one signal cycle.
requirements.rationale: Pedestrians get a guaranteed crossing opportunity without disturbing the vehicle phase sequence.

requirements.name: RUN_01_LoadScenario
requirements.text: When a load-scenario command is received, the system shall initialise the intersection, the agents, the timing plan and the random seed from that scenario.
requirements.rationale: Everything that determines a run comes from one scenario, so runs can be repeated and compared.

requirements.name: RUN_02_RejectInvalidTiming
requirements.text: If a requested signal duration is outside its permitted range (green 5-60 s, amber 2-5 s, all-red 1-3 s, walk 5-30 s), then the system shall reject the request and state the permitted range.
requirements.rationale: Out-of-range durations could make the signal plan unsafe; stating the range lets the operator correct the request. Ranges are those of the Milestone 1 ODD.
requirements.source: Road authority; operator; check T3; conflict C3

requirements.name: RUN_03_ApplyPlanAtAllRed
requirements.text: While a timing change is pending, the system shall keep the current timing plan until the next all-red interval begins.
requirements.rationale: A timing change can never cut short a green, amber or pedestrian interval that is already running.
requirements.source: Road authority; pedestrians; check T3; conflict C3

requirements.name: RUN_04_AcknowledgeCommand
requirements.text: When an operator command is received, the system shall acknowledge it as accepted or as rejected with a reason before the next simulation step.
requirements.rationale: The dashboard only requests changes and the model decides; the acknowledgement tells the operator what is actually in effect.

requirements.name: RUN_05_Pause
requirements.text: While a run is paused, the system shall keep the simulation time and every signal and agent state unchanged.
requirements.rationale: The operator can look at a situation in detail without it changing.

requirements.name: RUN_06_Reset
requirements.text: When a reset command is received, the system shall return to the initial state of the loaded scenario.
requirements.rationale: The operator can repeat a run, e.g. with another timing plan, without loading the scenario again.

requirements.name: AGT_01_UpdateAgents
requirements.text: The system shall update the position and speed of every agent once per simulation step.
requirements.rationale: Agent motion belongs to the model, not to the dashboard, and advances in the same steps as the signals.

requirements.name: AGT_02_NoEntryOnRed
requirements.text: While an approach shows red, the system shall prevent every vehicle agent on that approach from crossing its stop line.
requirements.rationale: Every vehicle, smart or conventional, obeys red.
requirements.source: Occupants; drivers; road authority; check T2; conflict C1

requirements.name: AGT_03_StopOnAmber
requirements.text: When an approach changes to amber, the system shall stop every vehicle agent on that approach that can stop before its stop line within its braking limit.
requirements.rationale: Vehicles that can stop do so; vehicles too close to stop clear the intersection. The braking limit is a parameter of the vehicle model, defined in the behaviour model.
requirements.source: Occupants; drivers; check T2; conflict C1

requirements.name: AGT_04_PedestrianStartsOnWalk
requirements.text: The system shall start a pedestrian agent across a crossing only while that crossing shows walk.
requirements.rationale: Pedestrians obey their signal, so together with SIG-03 they are always protected.

requirements.name: SV_01_DecideOnObservation
requirements.text: The system shall base every stop, yield or proceed decision of the smart vehicle on its observations instead of on the simulated ground truth.
requirements.rationale: The smart vehicle behaves like a real automated vehicle, and errors between observation and reality become visible and testable.

requirements.name: SV_02_MissingSignalIsRed
requirements.text: If the smart vehicle has no observation of its signal, then the system shall treat that signal as red for the smart vehicle.
requirements.rationale: Fail-safe: the smart vehicle never drives on a green it has not seen.
requirements.source: Occupants; pedestrians; check T5; conflict C4

requirements.name: OBS_01_StateSnapshot
requirements.text: The system shall publish one state snapshot per simulation step.
requirements.rationale: The dashboard shows only state owned by the model; a full snapshot every step means a lost message is replaced by the next one.

requirements.name: OBS_02_EventLog
requirements.text: When a logged event occurs, the system shall record it with its simulation time in the run log.
requirements.rationale: The run log is the evidence for verification (checks T1-T4) and the basis for comparing runs.

requirements.name: OBS_03_RunMetrics
requirements.text: When a run ends, the system shall report the run metrics.
requirements.rationale: Makes the trade-off between delay and safety of different timing plans measurable.
requirements.source: Operator / researcher; road authority; drivers; check T4; conflicts C1, C2

requirements.name: NFR_01_Reproducibility
requirements.text: The system shall produce identical run logs for any two runs of the same scenario with the same random seed.
requirements.rationale: A difference between two runs can then only come from the parameter that was changed.
requirements.source: Operator; course team; check T4; conflict C3

requirements.name: NFR_02_FixedTimeStep
requirements.text: The system shall advance the simulation time in steps of equal length.
requirements.rationale: Equal steps make the behaviour deterministic and independent of the computer speed (needed for NFR-01).

requirements.name: NFR_03_RejectMalformedMessage
requirements.text: If the system receives a message that does not conform to the interface specification, then the system shall discard the message and log a diagnostic event.
requirements.rationale: Faulty input from the dashboard or the test harness must not stop or corrupt a run.

requirements.name: ODD_01_IntersectionGeometry
requirements.text: The system shall represent one four-arm signalized intersection with right-hand traffic, one inbound and one outbound lane per arm, a stop line on each inbound lane and a pedestrian crossing on each arm.
requirements.rationale: Fixing the layout means every conflict between road users is known in advance and can be checked completely.

requirements.name: ODD_02_VehiclePopulation
requirements.text: The system shall simulate at most 4 vehicle agents at the same time, one of which is the smart vehicle.
requirements.rationale: Enough vehicles for interaction between the smart vehicle and conventional vehicles, with a bounded test effort (Milestone 1 ODD).

requirements.name: ODD_03_PedestrianPopulation
requirements.text: The system shall simulate at most 6 pedestrian agents at the same time.
requirements.rationale: Enough pedestrians to load all four crossings, with a bounded test effort (Milestone 1 ODD).

requirements.name: ODD_04_StraightThroughOnly
requirements.text: The system shall move vehicle agents straight through the intersection only, without turning, overtaking or reversing.
requirements.rationale: Limits the conflicts to the two crossing movement groups; turning is a later extension.

requirements.name: ODD_05_RejectOutOfOddScenario
requirements.text: If a scenario exceeds a limit of ODD-01 to ODD-04, then the system shall reject the scenario and state the exceeded limit.
requirements.rationale: Every run stays inside the domain for which the model is designed and verified.
requirements.source: Road authority; operator; course team; conflict C3

definitions: the system
the system of interest, block SmartIntersectionCore
vehicle movement group
the vehicles of the N/S arms or of the E/W arms, which receive the same signal
approach
the inbound lane of one arm with its stop line and vehicle signal
walk / clearance
pedestrian signal states in which pedestrians may start / may finish crossing
timing plan
the durations of green per group, amber, all-red and walk
simulation step
one fixed increment of simulation time in which all signals and agents are updated
state snapshot
simulation time, active phase, every signal indication, and id, type, position, speed and state of every agent
logged event
phase change, operator command, vehicle stop at a stop line, crossing request, crossing completion or safety-rule violation
run metrics
waiting time of every agent, maximum queue length per arm and number of vehicle stops
observation
what the smart vehicle perceives of signals, vehicles and pedestrians, as opposed to the simulated ground truth
